dedupe_keys.name: data from the u s agriculture and forestry greenhouse gas inventory 1990 2013 usda by report chapter

description: Tabulated data behind the figures, tables and maps of the USDA report U.S. Agriculture and Forestry Greenhouse Gas Inventory: 1990-2013. The Ag Data Commons record says the report estimates US agricultural greenhouse gas emissions, their uncertainty and mitigation potential: nitrous oxide from cropped and grazed soils, methane from ruminants and rice, methane and nitrous oxide from managed livestock waste, emissions from energy use in agriculture, and carbon uptake in forests, harvested wood and soils, giving net US emissions of 5,803 million tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent. The main record holds five zipped chapter files and a data dictionary in Excel (about 150 KB in total), with separate DOIs for chapter 1 (introduction), chapter 2 (livestock and grazed lands), chapter 4 (carbon stocks) and chapter 5 (energy use in agriculture), all in the US public domain and first issued in 2016. Coverage is the United States for 1990 to 2013. Caveats: the series ends in 2013 and is a static report dataset; later inventories are published separately. For simulation the energy use chapter gives fuel and electricity demand of US farms, and the emission tables support scenarios of farm energy and livestock waste management. Related catalogue records include the EPA Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program and the USDA ARMS farm survey.
